description_en: Queries the list of load balancers under a site and returns load balancing information. You can query by load balancer name. Paging is supported
description_zh: 查询站点下负载均衡器列表，返回站点下的负载均衡器信息。可以根据负载均衡器名称查询，支持分页
name: ListLoadBalancers

parameters.help_en: The page number settings for the paging query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for the paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The load balancing name. You can query by name
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡器名称，可以根据名称查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The name matching strategy when querying by name. Valid values:

fuzzy: fuzzy match.
exact: exact match
parameters.help_zh:
根据名称查询时，名称匹配策略：

fuzzy：模糊匹配；
exact：全匹配，等值查询
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Currently, only sorting by ID is supported. id indicates ascending order by ID, and -id indicates descending order by ID. The ID value is positively correlated with the creation time. If this parameter is not specified, the default sort order is descending by ID
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，现在只支持按id排序，id表示按id升序，-id表示按id降序，id大小和创建时间正相关，不传时默认按id降序排列
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

LoadBalancers.description_en: The list of load balancing instances returned in array format
LoadBalancers.description_zh: 数组格式，返回负载均衡器列表

items.description_en: The details of a load balancing instance

AdaptiveRouting.description_en: The cross-origin address pool back-to-origin configuration

FailoverAcrossPools.description_en:
Indicates whether cross-origin address pool failover is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
FailoverAcrossPools.description_zh:
是否跨源地址池回源。

true：是。
false: 否

OriginLevelRetry.description_en: Specifies whether to retry the next IP address when back-to-origin fails and the origin server is a domain name that resolves to multiple IP addresses
OriginLevelRetry.description_zh: 回源失败时，若源服务器是域名且解析出多个IP，则重试下一个IP

DefaultPools.description_en: The list of default address pool IDs

Description.description_en: The description of the load balancing instance
Description.description_zh: 负载均衡器的描述信息

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the load balancing instance is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
负载均衡器是否启用。

true：启用。
false：不启用

FallbackPool.description_en: The ID of the fallback address pool. When all other address pools are unavailable, traffic is redirected to this address pool
FallbackPool.description_zh: 兜底地址池ID，当所有其他地址池不可用时，流量将被重定向至此地址池

Id.description_en: The unique identity ID of the load balancing instance
Id.description_zh: 负载均衡器的唯一标识ID

ConsecutiveDown.description_en: The number of consecutive failed probes required to consider the check failed, such as 5
ConsecutiveDown.description_zh: 连续探测多少次失败算失败，如5

ConsecutiveUp.description_en: The number of consecutive successful probes required to consider the check successful, such as 3
ConsecutiveUp.description_zh: 连续探测多少次成功算成功，如3

ExpectedCodes.description_en: The expected status codes for a successful HTTP response, such as 200,202
ExpectedCodes.description_zh: 预期状态码，如200,202，成功的HTTP响应

FollowRedirects.description_en:
Indicates whether to follow redirects. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No
FollowRedirects.description_zh:
是否跟随重定向。

true：是。
false：否

Header.description_en: The HTTP header information included in the probe request
Header.description_zh: 探测时所带头部信息，HTTP头

Interval.description_en: The interval of the health check, in seconds
Interval.description_zh: 应用健康检查的间隔时间，单位秒

Method.description_en: The method used for the health check
Method.description_zh: 应用的健康检查的方法

MonitoringRegion.description_en:
The region where the probe nodes are located. Default value: Global. Valid values:

Global: worldwide.
ChineseMainland: the Chinese mainland.
OutsideChineseMainland: worldwide (excluding the Chinese mainland)
MonitoringRegion.description_zh:
探测点所在区域，默认为Global，

Global: 全球。
ChineseMainland: 中国内地。
OutsideChineseMainland: 全球（不包括中国内地）

Timeout.description_en: The timeout period of the health check, in seconds
Timeout.description_zh: 应用健康检查超时时间，单位为秒

Type.description_en: The monitor protocol type, such as HTTP, used for health checks. A value of off indicates that no health check is performed
Type.description_zh: 监视器协议类型，如HTTP，用于健康检查，值为off时，表示不进行检查

Name.description_en: The name of the load balancing instance

RandomSteering.description_en: The weighted round-robin configuration, which controls the traffic distribution weight across different address pools
RandomSteering.description_zh: 加权轮询配置，用于控制不同地址池的流量分配权重

DefaultWeight.description_en: The weight configuration for each backend server pool. The key is the pool ID and the value is the weight coefficient. The weight coefficient represents the relative proportion of traffic distribution
DefaultWeight.description_zh: 各后端服务器池的权重配置，键为池ID，值为权重系数。权重系数表示相对流量分配的比例

additionalProperties.description_en: The weight value. Valid values: 0 to 100. A value of 0 indicates that no traffic is routed to the origin server
additionalProperties.description_zh: 权重的值，0-100的数字，0表示不往该源服务器调度流量

PoolWeights.description_en: The weight configuration for each backend server pool. The key is the pool ID and the value is the weight coefficient
PoolWeights.description_zh: 各后端服务器池的权重配置，键为池ID，值为权重系数

RegionPools.description_en: The address pools mapped to primary regions

Rules.description_en: The list of rule configurations that define behaviors under specific conditions
Rules.description_zh: 规则配置列表，用于定义特定条件下的行为

items.description_en: The rule configuration in the rule set

FixedResponse.description_en: The fixed response content returned after a rule is matched
FixedResponse.description_zh: 匹配规则后执行响应指定内容

ContentType.description_en: The Content-Type field in the HTTP header

Location.description_en: The location field in the HTTP response

Overrides.description_en: The load balancing configuration overrides applied after a rule is matched. The configured fields override the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration
Overrides.description_zh: 匹配规则后修改对应请求改写的负载均衡配置，配置的字段，会覆盖负载均衡器配置里相应的字段

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A higher value indicates higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越大越优先执行

Terminates.description_en:
Indicates whether to stop executing subsequent rules. Valid values:

true: Yes.
false: No. This is the default value
Terminates.description_zh:
是否终止执行后续规则。

true：是。
false：否，默认值

SessionAffinity.description_en:
The session persistence mode. Valid values:
off: Disabled.
ip: IP-based session persistence.
cookie: Cookie-based session persistence.
http_header: HTTP header-based session persistence
SessionAffinity.description_zh:
会话保持，取值：
off：不开启。
ip：按IP方式会话保持。
cookie: 按cookie方式会话保持。
http_header：按 http header 方式会话保持

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site to which the load balancing instance belongs
SiteId.description_zh: 负载均衡器所归属的站点ID

Status.description_en: The status of the load balancing instance

SubRegionPools.description_en: The address pools mapped to secondary regions. When multiple secondary regions share the same set of address pools, the secondary region names can be concatenated with commas as the key
SubRegionPools.description_zh: 二级region对应的地址池，多个二级region共用一批地址池时，可以多个二级region，使用逗号拼接作为key

Ttl.description_en: The TTL value, which specifies the time-to-live of the DNS record. Default value: 30
Ttl.description_zh: TTL值，DNS记录的生存时间，默认为30

PageNumber.description_en: The page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
